# rbitcoin 199-block cache

Generated by `../create_cache.py` (not committed). Contains our `store/`
at height 199 — **not** Core `blocks/` + LevelDB.

`run.sh` preseeds empty `third_party/bitcoin/test/cache/node0/regtest/{blocks,chainstate}`
so Core skips remine, then the bitcoind shim copies this `store/` into each
`setup_clean_chain=False` node.
